description: Write: change what a neuron says without deleting anything — for what stopped being true, or never was, with nothing replacing it (a replacement is crbro_learn with supersedes; what must not exist on disk, crbro_forget). facts and entries take a status: superseded or retracted retire them (kept in the file, gone from recall), active reactivates, and status verified records a check against the source. summary, domain, tags and name edit metadata in the same call; the id never changes. move_to splits: the listed entries go to another neuron with their dates. Anything in unmatched is STILL LIVE: fix and re-run.

entries.description: Decisions, patterns, errors or debts by exact text (or id with verified and move_to).

evidence.description: With verified: source = you checked the reference; user = the user confirmed.

facts.description: Fact ids (entry_id from crbro_recall) or exact text.

move_to.description: Split: move the listed facts/entries to this neuron id or name (created if missing), dates kept. Refused on a shared neuron.

name.description: Rename; id, file and links stay.

status.description: superseded (default: newer truth exists), retracted (never true), active (reactivate) or verified (still holds at its source).

summary.description: New neuron summary; credentials are redacted.

tags.description: Replaces the WHOLE tag list; on protocol neurons re-send priority: and source:.

name: crbro_revise
title: Revise a neuron
